shapeSummary: Flat 8 mm thick aluminum clamping hub: 40 mm OD ring with a 32 mm through bore, four 8 mm-diameter ears with 4 mm holes on a 32 mm square pattern, and a 14 mm wide clamp block at the top with a 2 mm slit into the bore and a 3 mm cross hole for the clamp screw. Bottom sits at Y=0 and the part is centered in X and Z.
warnings: Product data has no dimensions; sizes are scaled from the image using the 32 mm bore as reference and are unverified.
Thickness of 8 mm, ear hole diameter of 4 mm, and screw hole diameter of 3 mm are estimates.
Clamp block width of 14 mm, its height, and the screw hole position are visual estimates; the analysis JSON screw Y of 20.4 was not used because it conflicts with the block height.
The cap screw itself is omitted, so only the cross hole is modeled.
Small fillets where the ears blend into the ring are not modeled.
cadquery:
cy = 19.9
ring = cq.Workplane('XY').center(0, cy).circle(20).extrude(4, both=True)
pts = [(-16, cy-16), (16, cy-16), (-16, cy+16), (16, cy+16)]
ears = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints(pts).circle(4).extrude(4, both=True)
block = cq.Workplane('XY').box(14, 11.1, 8).translate((0, cy + 17.55, 0))
body = ring.union(ears).union(block)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').center(0, cy).circle(16).extrude(10, both=True)
holes = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints(pts).circle(2).extrude(10, both=True)
slit = cq.Workplane('XY').box(2, 25, 12).translate((0, cy + 12.5, 0))
screw = cq.Workplane('YZ').center(cy + 18, 0).circle(1.5).extrude(10, both=True)
part = body.cut(bore).cut(holes).cut(slit).cut(screw)
